notes.title: Thank you for play this game
notes.notes: [p]"Don't Look Behind" has been released for a week now, and I would like to thank everyone who like the game. [/p][p]I have noticed that there are still many thing of the game that need improvement, and I am sorry if the game has not met your expectations.[/p][p]I'll try to bring you an even more exciting and interesting game next time.[/p][p]So now I need to work hard on my next idea.[/p][p]Hope to see you all soon :)[/p]
